story_title: Los Angeles Deaths in 1992: Patterns and Context
story_subtitle: Analyzing demographics, locations, and causes of death during a period of social unrest

story_pieces.narration: Black individuals account for 28 of the 63 recorded deaths, while Latino individuals make up 19 of the deaths.
story_pieces.question: How does the racial distribution of deaths compare to the racial demographics of Los Angeles during this period?

story_pieces.narration: The age distribution reveals a disproportionately high number of young individuals aged 15-25, with 1 death in this age range compared to 2 deaths among those aged 50 and over.
story_pieces.question: Which age groups were most affected by deaths during this period?

story_pieces.narration: Homicide accounts for 36 of the 63 deaths, while Officer-involved shootings make up 10 deaths, highlighting the varied causes of mortality during this time period.
